subject: learning/code-pyxis-scripts-startup-codex-worktree.zsh-ba475338ed7c
statement: The sourced zsh wrapper intercepts only fresh interactive top-level Codex launches in a .pyxis-adopted primary checkout, fetches origin/main, creates a no-track chore branch in a sibling linked worktree, preserves supported CLI and local-path arguments, and launches there; subcommands, existing worktrees, help or version, noninteractive calls, and non-adopted repositories pass through unchanged.
intent: Isolate new interactive agent work from the shared primary checkout without changing Codex behavior outside the narrow opted-in launch case.
rationale: A fresh session otherwise inherits and can disturb the primary checkout; a disposable linked worktree gives it a current mainline base while preserving the caller's checkout and native command semantics.
fit_criterion: The startup PTY integration suite proves adopted-repository and --cd discovery, origin/main fetch and worktree creation, argument and attachment-path preservation, all pass-through cases, failure propagation, and the opt-in real-Codex trust-check regression.

provenance.note: Semantic memory for the sourced startup wrapper newly admitted to production-code inventory.
